title: Detailed description of UE behaviour in state EMM-DEREGISTERED

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where the UE is not registered with the network and cannot access services.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to register with the network and transition to EMM-REGISTERED state.

entities.name: UE-initiated attach
entities.description: Condition where the UE decides to initiate the attach procedure based on internal triggers.

relations.description: The attach procedure is initiated when the UE is in EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
UE-initiated condition triggers the start of the attach procedure.
